description:
Ocean Lettings and Management are proud to present a superb two bedroom garden flat set within an attractive period building on Chandos Road, Redland. Offered unfurnished, the property features an entrance hall leading to a lounge/diner leading to rear garden through patio doors and separate kitchen with fridge/freezer and washing machine. One double bedroom and one single bedroom are found off the entrance hall as well. Between the kitchen and lounge is the main bathroom with white suite and a shower over bath. At the rear of the property is a large north-west facing garden. 

Suitable for either a single occupant or couple, Chandos Road is within comfortable walking distance to Whiteladies Road and is easily commutable to Gloucester Road and the City Centre.
